name: Malaysian Business Websites
description:
## About Malaysian Corporate Websites

We've partnered with leading Malaysian businesses to create world-class digital presences. Our corporate website solutions combine stunning design with practical business functionality.

### Our Approach

Discovery: We learn about your industry, competitors, and goals. Strategy: We develop a digital strategy aligned with your objectives. Design: We create unique designs that reflect your brand. Development: We build robust, scalable websites. Launch & Support: We ensure smooth deployment and ongoing success.

### Industries We Serve

Manufacturing, Finance & Banking, Real Estate, Healthcare, Education, and Hospitality.

### Malaysian Market Expertise

Multi-language support (English, BM, Chinese), local payment integration (FPX, TNG), cultural sensitivity, and PDPA regulatory compliance.

## Results That Matter

Our clients typically see 200%+ increase in website traffic, 150%+ increase in online inquiries, improved search engine rankings, and enhanced brand perception.

faq.question: How long does it take to build a corporate website?
faq.answer: A typical corporate website takes 4-8 weeks from initial consultation to launch, depending on complexity and content readiness.

faq.question: Do you provide ongoing maintenance?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer monthly maintenance packages that include updates, backups, security monitoring, and content updates.

faq.question: Can you help with content creation?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We have copywriters who can create professional content in English, Malay, and Chinese.

faq.question: What about domain and hosting?
faq.answer: We handle everything — domain registration, SSL certificates, and Malaysian-based hosting with excellent uptime guarantees.
